# Markdy

> Open-source DSL for animated architecture and system diagrams — write plain text, get browser-native animated diagrams. A Mermaid alternative with motion.

Markdy lets developers declare nodes, groups, beats, and flow operators (`->`, `<-`, `~>`, `--`) in MarkdyScript. It is useful for animated architecture diagrams, system-design explainers, sequence flows, infrastructure diagrams, CI/CD and Kubernetes diagrams, product walkthroughs, Astro sites, MDX content, and AI-generated diagrams.

## Short Description

Markdy is an open-source animation DSL and animated diagram scripting language. Write MarkdyScript text files, parse them with @markdy/core, and render animated browser scenes with @markdy/renderer-dom. The architecture node vocabulary ships inside @markdy/core for infrastructure diagrams, request/response/event flows, and technical visualizations.

## Best AI Context

Use docs/AGENT.md as the complete reference when generating MarkdyScript. It contains the grammar, node kinds, flow operators (`->`, `<-`, `~>`, `--`), beats, cues, examples, and constraints. Prefer practical scenes: architecture diagrams, API flows, CI/CD pipelines, Kubernetes diagrams, data pipelines, security reviews, product explainers, and developer education.

## Install

```sh
npm i @markdy/core @markdy/renderer-dom
```

## Minimal Scene

```markdy
scene "Hello Markdy" theme=midnight
layout LR

browser Web
service API

beat main:
  show $nodes
  Web -> API "GET /users"
```
